<!-- ==== Block 7: SERVICES - Stack + Engagement (NEW, page-specific) ==== -->
<script>
/* PMC /services - STACK + ENGAGEMENT (v1.0)
   Page-scoped IIFE. Run-once guarded by __pmc_services_page.
   - Stack row expand/collapse via aria-expanded + data-open attr
   - Pairs-with deep links open the target row
   - Sticky left-rail scroll spy by data-layer
   - Engagement card line-draw on IntersectionObserver
   - Engagement keyboard nav (ArrowLeft / ArrowRight)
   - Hash deep link (location.hash) auto-opens the matching service row */
(function () {
  if (window.__pmc_services_page) return;
  window.__pmc_services_page = true;
  try { if (window.Webflow && Webflow.env && Webflow.env('design')) return; } catch (e) {}
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  function openRow(row) {
    if (!row) return;
    var btn = row.querySelector('.pmc-stack-toggle');
    if (!btn) return;
    row.setAttribute('data-open', '');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  }
  function closeRow(row) {
    var btn = row.querySelector('.pmc-stack-toggle');
    if (!btn) return;
    row.removeAttribute('data-open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }

  function init() {
    /* ===== STACK: row toggles ===== */
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.pmc-services .pmc-stack-row');
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var btn = row.querySelector('.pmc-stack-toggle');
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (row.hasAttribute('data-open')) closeRow(row);
        else openRow(row);
      });
    });

    /* ===== STACK: pairs-with deep links open the target row ===== */
    document.querySelectorAll('.pmc-services .pmc-stack-pair').forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var href = a.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href || href.charAt(0) !== '#') return;
        var target = document.querySelector(href);
        if (!target) return;
        if (!target.hasAttribute('data-open')) openRow(target);
      });
    });

    /* ===== STACK: hash deep link on load ===== */
    if (location.hash && location.hash.indexOf('#svc-') === 0) {
      var deepTarget = document.querySelector(location.hash);
      if (deepTarget) {
        openRow(deepTarget);
        setTimeout(function () {
          deepTarget.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }, 120);
      }
    }

    /* ===== STACK: left-rail scroll spy ===== */
    if (!reduce && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var rail = document.querySelector('.pmc-services .pmc-stack-rail');
      if (rail) {
        var layerEls = rail.querySelectorAll('[data-layer]');
        var byLayer = {};
        layerEls.forEach(function (el) { byLayer[el.dataset.layer] = el; });
        var spyIO = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (e) {
            if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
            var layer = e.target.dataset.layer;
            layerEls.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('is-active'); });
            if (byLayer[layer]) byLayer[layer].classList.add('is-active');
          });
        }, { threshold: 0, rootMargin: '-40% 0px -55% 0px' });
        document.querySelectorAll('.pmc-services .pmc-stack-row').forEach(function (r) { spyIO.observe(r); });
      }
    }

    /* ===== ENGAGEMENT: line draw + keyboard nav ===== */
    var track = document.querySelector('.pmc-services .pmc-engage-track');
    if (track) {
      if (!reduce && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var drawIO = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.isIntersecting) {
              e.target.classList.add('is-drawn');
              drawIO.unobserve(e.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.4 });
        track.querySelectorAll('.pmc-engage-card').forEach(function (c) { drawIO.observe(c); });
      } else {
        track.querySelectorAll('.pmc-engage-card').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.add('is-drawn'); });
      }
      track.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      track.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && e.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
        var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.querySelectorAll('.pmc-engage-card'));
        if (!cards.length) return;
        var rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        var center = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
        var active = cards.reduce(function (best, c) {
          var r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
          var d = Math.abs((r.left + r.width / 2) - center);
          return (best == null || d < best.d) ? { el: c, d: d } : best;
        }, null);
        if (!active) return;
        var idx = cards.indexOf(active.el);
        var nextIdx = e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? Math.max(0, idx - 1) : Math.min(cards.length - 1, idx + 1);
        cards[nextIdx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
        e.preventDefault();
      });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>


<!-- ==== Block 8: PMC ICON SYSTEM - defs injection + IntersectionObserver ==== -->
<script>
/* PMC /services - ICON SYSTEM (v1.0)
   Injects the gLeaf / gGold gradients + bloomG filter into the DOM once
   (so embed HTML stays style/script-free per repo rule). Then sets up
   the IntersectionObserver that adds .go to each .pmc-ico on scroll-in,
   and hover-replay on the icon's nearest card. Reduced-motion short-circuits. */
(function () {
  if (window.__pmc_icons) return;
  window.__pmc_icons = true;
  try { if (window.Webflow && Webflow.env && Webflow.env('design')) return; } catch (e) {}

  function injectDefs() {
    if (document.getElementById('pmc-icon-defs')) return;
    var defs = '<svg id="pmc-icon-defs" width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden" aria-hidden="true">'
      + '<defs>'
      + '<linearGradient id="gLeaf" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">'
        + '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#3A6536"/>'
        + '<stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#5FA354"/>'
        + '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#7FD972"/>'
      + '</linearGradient>'
      + '<linearGradient id="gGold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">'
        + '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#BE9426"/>'
        + '<stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#D7AF33"/>'
        + '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#E6C765"/>'
      + '</linearGradient>'
      + '<filter id="bloomG" x="-120%" y="-120%" width="340%" height="340%">'
        + '<feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="2" result="b"/>'
        + '<feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>'
      + '</filter>'
      + '</defs>'
      + '</svg>';
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.innerHTML = defs;
    document.body.insertBefore(wrap.firstChild, document.body.firstChild);
  }

  function init() {
    injectDefs();
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (reduce) return;
    var icos = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pmc-ico'));
    if (!icos.length) return;
    function play(el) { el.classList.add('go'); }
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (e) {
          if (e.isIntersecting) { play(e.target); io.unobserve(e.target); }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.4 });
      icos.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
    } else {
      icos.forEach(play);
    }
    icos.forEach(function (el) {
      var host = el.closest('.pmc-leak-card, .pmc-engage-card, .pmc-stack-row, [data-pmc-aw]') || el.parentElement;
      if (!host) return;
      host.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
        el.classList.remove('go');
        void el.offsetWidth;
        el.classList.add('go');
      });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
